sentence: If I ___ more money, I would buy a new car.
explanation: Segundo condicional: If + pasado simple. 'Had' es la forma pasada que se necesita aquí.

sentence: The report ___ been finished by the team yesterday.
explanation: Pasado perfecto pasivo: had + been + participio pasado.

sentence: She asked me ___ I had ever visited London.
explanation: Pregunta cerrada en estilo indirecto: asked + if/whether + sujeto + verbo.

sentence: He ___ working here since 2018.
explanation: Presente perfecto continuo: has/have + been + -ing. Duración que llega hasta ahora.

sentence: You shouldn't ___ eaten so much cake.
explanation: Modal perfecto: shouldn't + have + participio pasado = crítica sobre el pasado.

sentence: ___ the rain, they decided to go for a walk.
explanation: 'Despite' + sustantivo/gerundio = conector de contraste.

sentence: The woman ___ works in the bakery is very friendly.
explanation: El pronombre relativo 'who' se usa para personas en cláusulas especificativas.

sentence: I wish I ___ speak French fluently.
explanation: Wish + could = deseo irreal en presente sobre una habilidad.

sentence: He suggested ___ to the cinema instead of the restaurant.
explanation: 'Suggest' va seguido de la forma -ing.

sentence: Not only ___ she pass the exam, but she also got top marks.
explanation: Inversión después de 'Not only': Not only + auxiliar + sujeto.

sentence: I'm used to ___ up early for work.
explanation: 'Be used to' va seguido de -ing (gerundio), no de la forma base.

sentence: The ___ you practise, the better you get.
explanation: Comparativo doble: The more..., the better...

sentence: She told me that she ___ already seen the film.
explanation: Retroceso verbal en estilo indirecto: presente perfecto → pasado perfecto.

sentence: The building, ___ was designed in 1920, is now a museum.
explanation: Cláusula relativa explicativa para cosas: , which + verbo.

sentence: If you ___ her, could you give her this message?
explanation: Primer condicional: If + presente simple, modal + verbo base.

sentence: By the time we arrived, the film ___ already started.
explanation: Pasado perfecto: had + participio para una acción anterior a otra acción pasada.

sentence: This house needs ___ before winter.
explanation: 'Need' + gerundio tiene sentido pasivo: needs repairing = needs to be repaired.

sentence: Hardly ___ he arrived when the phone rang.
explanation: Inversión con 'hardly': Hardly + had + sujeto + participio.

sentence: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.
explanation: 'Whose' es el pronombre relativo posesivo para personas.

sentence: It's high time you ___ your homework.
explanation: 'It's (high) time' + pasado simple expresa que algo debería haber pasado ya.
